没中文 没成就 《IQ 建设中》 《IQ 建设中》 当我们说 “我们正在制作一款趣味游戏” 时，没想到会变成这样。 《IQ 建设中》是一场逐步升级的疯狂之旅，你和你的朋友们被一种神秘能量连接在一起（别问它怎么运作的 —— 我们自己也没完全搞明白）。关键是别彼此离得太远，不然…… 各就各位，预备，开始 —— 回到起点！ 你们从底部出发，不断往高处攀登，克服巧妙设置的障碍，跃过危险的建筑结构，还会在语音聊天里惊慌尖叫（当然，想叫就叫）。这款游戏就像友谊：要是有人决定单干，所有人都得游戏结束。 🔍 游戏内容有啥？ 🚀 难度递增的垂直攀爬 一开始，啥都很轻松。几乎算得上可爱。但到了新场景，建筑结构就变得恶劣起来。跳跃平台、会消失的方块、那些陷阱，明显是某个通宵没合眼、毫无良知的人想出来的。 🔗 玩家间的连接机制 你不能随心所欲乱跑 —— 游戏世界可不答应。要是有人飞得太远，整个小队都得飞回去。好玩吧？ 🌆 场景不同，恶劣逻辑如一 世界是同一个，但里面的关卡完全不同。建筑风格、节奏、陷阱 —— 一切都在不断变化，就是为了让你没法放松，没法觉得 “好了，现在肯定会容易些”。 👥 单人或与好友同玩 想安静些？单人玩。想要混乱、笑声、尖叫和精神支持？游戏支持最多 4 人在线游玩。关键是要记住：一人跌倒，全员跌倒。 🎨 视觉友好（但可能让神经紧张）的风格 色彩缤纷的场景、简洁的形状，所有东西都在动、在发光，还在逗你。平台看着简单？有问题。得检查两遍。 🎵 助你保持理智的音乐 配乐会跟着你变化。平静时刻听起来很悦耳…… 然后到了得毫米级跳跃的平台，音乐声就突然不再是背景音乐那种存在感了（变得很关键） 。

IQ Under Construction has had a significant impact on my life. Before playing it, I often doubted my abilities and believed that intelligence was something fixed. This game changed the way I think about learning, personal growth, and success. One of the most valuable lessons I learned is that intelligence can be developed through effort, practice, and persistence. The game motivated me to challenge myself, learn from mistakes, and focus on continuous improvement rather than perfection. Since applying the ideas from the game, I have become more confident in my studies and daily life. I am more willing to take on difficult tasks and view setbacks as opportunities to learn. My mindset has become more positive, and I feel more motivated to achieve my goals. Overall, IQ Under Construction is an inspiring and thought-provoking game. It helped me develop a growth mindset and changed the way I approach challenges. I would highly recommend it to anyone who wants to improve themselves and unlock their potential.

IQ Under Construction is a cooperative platforming adventure developed and published by PoseidonPlay that revolves around a simple but effective concept: climbing upward while trying not to drag your teammates down with you. Built around teamwork, precision movement, and a healthy amount of frustration, the game challenges players to navigate a towering obstacle course filled with hazards, difficult jumps, and unexpected setbacks. While its premise appears straightforward, the multiplayer mechanics transform what could have been an ordinary platformer into a chaotic social experience where communication and coordination often matter more than individual skill. The game's main objective is to reach the top of an enormous vertical challenge packed with increasingly demanding obstacles. Players must jump across platforms, avoid traps, and carefully manage their movement while progressing through a series of difficult environments. What makes the experience stand out is the way it ties players together. Progress is rarely a solo achievement, as the game constantly encourages cooperation through mechanics that force participants to remain aware of one another. This design creates a constant sense of shared responsibility where every successful jump benefits the team and every mistake has the potential to create disaster. One of the game's greatest strengths is its ability to generate memorable multiplayer moments. Few things are more entertaining than watching a perfectly coordinated climb suddenly collapse because one player misjudged a jump. These situations often create a mixture of laughter, frustration, and determination that fuels the entire experience. The game thrives on these emotional swings, turning simple platforming challenges into dramatic stories that players are likely to remember long after the session ends. Success feels genuinely rewarding because it requires cooperation rather than simply relying on individual performance. The platforming mechanics themselves are easy to understand but difficult to master. Basic movement can be learned quickly, making the game approachable even for players with limited experience in the genre. However, as the climb continues, the demands placed on players steadily increase. Narrow ledges, moving platforms, hazardous obstacles, and precision-based jumps require greater concentration and timing. This gradual increase in difficulty ensures that the challenge remains engaging while allowing players to improve naturally as they progress. The level design contributes significantly to the overall experience. Each section introduces new obstacles and environmental themes that keep the climb from feeling repetitive. While the objective remains the same throughout the game, the journey continually evolves through fresh challenges and layouts. Players never spend too long dealing with a single type of obstacle before something new is introduced. This variety helps maintain momentum and encourages players to continue pushing forward despite inevitable setbacks. Visually, IQ Under Construction adopts a colorful and accessible presentation that prioritizes clarity over complexity. The environments are bright and easy to read, ensuring that players can quickly identify hazards and navigate difficult sections without unnecessary confusion. The art style may not be particularly advanced from a technical standpoint, but it serves the gameplay well by keeping important information visible during intense platforming sequences. The playful visuals also help soften some of the frustration that naturally accompanies repeated failures. The audio design complements the gameplay effectively. Music provides a steady sense of energy during the climb, while sound effects offer satisfying feedback for successful jumps and interactions. The soundtrack helps maintain a lighthearted atmosphere even when players encounter particularly challenging sections. Combined with the inevitable reactions from friends during multiplayer sessions, the sound design contributes to the game's social appeal and keeps the experience lively. Replay value comes primarily from the multiplayer component. Every group approaches challenges differently, and the unpredictable nature of human error ensures that no two sessions unfold exactly the same way. Even after learning the layouts and obstacle patterns, the behavior of teammates introduces enough variability to keep repeated runs entertaining. The game understands that its greatest asset is not necessarily the obstacle course itself but the interactions it creates between players attempting to conquer it together. That said, IQ Under Construction is not without shortcomings. The core concept, while enjoyable, may feel familiar to players who have already experienced other cooperative climbing games and rage-platformers. The challenge can occasionally become repetitive, particularly when repeated failures force players to retrace the same sections multiple times. Some players may also wish for greater environmental variety or additional gameplay mechanics beyond the central climbing concept. These limitations prevent the game from reaching the same level as the most polished entries in the genre. Nevertheless, the title succeeds because it understands its audience. It is not attempting to be a complex adventure or a narrative-driven experience. Instead, it focuses entirely on creating situations where teamwork, communication, and perseverance are tested in entertaining ways. The frustration generated by difficult obstacles is balanced by the satisfaction of finally overcoming them, especially when that success is shared with friends. IQ Under Construction delivers a straightforward but enjoyable platforming experience built around cooperation and persistence. Its accessible controls, challenging obstacle courses, colorful presentation, and emphasis on teamwork make it an entertaining choice for players looking to tackle difficult challenges with friends. While it may not introduce groundbreaking ideas, it successfully captures the appeal of cooperative climbing games and provides plenty of opportunities for both triumph and hilarious failure. Rating: 7/10
